status: source-derived draft vectors, unexecuted and unapproved

criteria.text: A stopped motor with no pending alarm schedules the ordinary startup callback at current clock plus 32000; retain an existing alarm as VICE does. FORWARD/REWIND commands schedule their 1000-cycle alarm independently of motor-running state, including motor-on before and after that alarm dispatch. Compare ordered scheduled and actual events, not a pulse-duration getter. Also cover START while the motor is already running, with absent, read-only and writable media, with no pending alarm and with an existing pending alarm. The command reaches the start helper after resetting the gap: install t+32000 only when no alarm is pending, otherwise preserve the existing alarm; match attached-image seek, current-clock write-clock seeding and write-bit zeroing, including clock zero. Contrast START with running-motor FORWARD/REWIND, whose earlier t+1000 alarm survives the helper, and preserve any stop deadline that the command does not clear.

Motor-off on a running motor sets a stop deadline of current clock plus 32000 without immediate stopping or replacing an already pending alarm. Actual stopping occurs when a datasette callback observes the deadline reached. Cover callbacks before, at and beyond the deadline, active read rescheduling, STOP with a retained later alarm, repeated off preserving the deadline, and motor-on cancellation even after the deadline but before stop execution. A stopped motor starts again through the native pending-alarm rule. Explicitly include motor-on before the stop deadline and at the deadline before callback dispatch, preserving the already-running motor, pending alarm and write state while clearing the stop deadline; neither case starts a new ramp.

scope: motor/alarm state projection at routine boundary; does not establish whole tape behavior or real reachability

tupleContract.alarmAt: null means no pending datasette alarm; zero means pending at clock zero
tupleContract.mode: current image mode if attached, otherwise notape_mode

commonPreconditions: event playback false and network disconnected

seekFixture.appliesTo: SeekIfAttached vectors; not the separate active-read gap fixture

eventArgumentRules.AlarmUnset: consume the pending datasette alarm before deadline comparison
eventArgumentRules.SeekIfAttached: none: no seek; read-only or writable: fd seek to logicalSeek+imageOffset
